definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named triLoopCondition proof term as the exact comparison AST; it adds no mathematical fact or execution behavior.
Macro expansion defining the named triLoopBody proof term as the exact nested branch, append, and increment AST.
definitions.text:
rule triLoopBody
    => If(Compare(Name("i"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
          Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("values"), "append"), Int(1))),
          If(Compare(Name("i"), CmpOp("==", Int(1))),
            Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("values"), "append"), Int(3))),
            If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("i"), Int(2)),
                       CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
              Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("values"), "append"),
                        BinOp("+", Int(1),
                                   BinOp("//", Name("i"), Int(2))))),
              Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("values"), "append"),
                        BinOp("*",
                          BinOp("+", BinOp("//", Name("i"), Int(2)), Int(1)),
                          BinOp("+", BinOp("//", Name("i"), Int(2)), Int(3))))))))
       AugAssign(Name("i"), "+", Int(1))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining triFunctionBody by composing initialization, the named loop syntax, and return into the exact function-body AST.
definitions.text:
rule triFunctionBody
    => Assign(Name("values"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
       Assign(Name("i"), Int(0))
       While(triLoopCondition, triLoopBody)
       Return(Name("values"))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining triDefinition as the named function-definition AST with the required tri signature and triFunctionBody.
Guarded equation totalizing the mathematical summary triValue on negative indices, which are outside the proved input domain.
Guarded defining equation for triValue at nonnegative odd indices, using the closed-form value constructed by the program.
definitions.text:
rule triValue(I:Int)
    => ((I -Int pyMod(I, 2)) /Int 2 +Int 1)
       *Int ((I -Int pyMod(I, 2)) /Int 2 +Int 3)
    requires I >=Int 0 andBool pyMod(I, 2) ==Int 1

definitions.rationale: Guarded defining equation for triValue at nonnegative even indices, including index zero.
definitions.text:
rule triValue(I:Int)
    => 1 +Int (I -Int pyMod(I, 2)) /Int 2
    requires I >=Int 0 andBool pyMod(I, 2) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining triComplete to return its accumulated prefix once the current index is past the bound.
definitions.text:
rule triComplete(P:ValSeq, I:Int, N:Int) => P
    requires I >Int N

definitions.rationale: Recursive defining equation for triComplete that appends the current triValue and advances the index while it remains within the bound.
definitions.text:
rule triComplete(P:ValSeq, I:Int, N:Int)
    => triComplete(
         valSeqConcat(P, vCons(triValue(I), .ValSeq)),
         I +Int 1,
         N)
    requires I <=Int N

definitions.rationale: Unconditional wrapper equation defining triResult as triComplete from the empty prefix at index zero.
